[[module CSS]]
/* Korean SCP branch Dear Dictator theme, ported for SCP-JP; source and asset hashes are in PORT.md. */
:root {
  --towerleft: max(calc(50% - 675px), -40px);
  --towerwidth: 280px;
  --slogan1: "異常教化戦線を徹底構築し";
  --slogan2: "祖国主体革命の力となれ!!";
  --slogan1m: "異常教化戦線を";
  --slogan2m: "徹底構築せよ!!";

  --text: #222;
  --red: #892B21;
  --gold: #C6AF5F;
  --bg: #FFF;
  --paper: #EDEDEA;
  --brown: #362622;
}

body, html, #container {
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

body, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
  font-family: "Yu Gothic", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", Meiryo, "IPAPGothic", sans-serif;
  color: var(--text);
}

a, a:visited, a.newpage, #side-bar a {
  color: var(--gold); text-shadow: 0 0 1px var(--gold);
}

div#container-wrap { background: none; }
#container { margin-bottom: 26px; }
#footer, #footer a { background: none; color: var(--text); }
#license-area {
  display: block;
  padding: 1rem;
  color: var(--text);
  background: var(--paper);
}
#license-area a { color: var(--red); text-decoration: underline; }
#content-wrap, #main-content { position: static; }

#header { background: none; height: 200px; }

#header h1 {
  margin-left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
}

#header h1 a {
  color: transparent;
  text-shadow: none;
  transform: scaleX(1.2) rotate(-5deg); }

#header h1 a::before {
  content: var(--slogan1) "　\A　" var(--slogan2) "\A";
  color: var(--red);
  text-shadow: 3px 3px var(--gold), 2px 2px 2px var(--bg), 2px -2px 2px var(--bg), -2px 2px 2px var(--bg), -2px -2px 2px var(--bg), 3px 0 2px var(--bg), 0 3px 2px var(--bg), -3px 0 2px var(--bg), 0 -3px 2px var(--bg), 5px 5px 2px var(--bg), 5px 1px 2px var(--bg), 1px 5px 2px var(--bg), 1px 1px 2px var(--bg), 6px 3px 2px var(--bg), 3px 6px 2px var(--bg), 0 3px 2px var(--bg), 3px 0 2px var(--bg);
  font-family: "Yu Mincho", "Hiragino Mincho ProN", "IPAMincho", serif;
  font-style: italic;
  white-space: pre;
  line-height: 1.1;
}

#header h2 { display: none; }

#login-status { position: fixed; right: unset; top: -3px; left: 10px; z-index: 14; font-size: 100%; }
#login-status, #login-status a { color: var(--bg); }

#login-status .printuser { font-size: 0; }
#login-status .printuser img.small { transform: translate(5px, 5px); }

#account-options { right: unset; left: 0; }
#account-options li a:hover { color: var(--gold); }

#top-bar { position: fixed; top: 0; right: unset; z-index: 13; font-size: 100%; }
#top-bar .top-bar, #top-bar .mobile-top-bar { justify-content: center; width: 100%; }
#top-bar ul { float: none !important; }

#top-bar ul li.sfhover a, #top-bar ul li:hover a, #login-status ul a {
  background: var(--red);
  color: var(--bg);
}

#top-bar ul li:hover a:hover {
  background: var(--gold);
  color: var(--bg);
}

.c_topbar_arrow {
  color: var(--gold);
}

#search-top-box { position: fixed; top: 0; z-index: 14;}
#search-top-box-form input[type="submit"],
#search-top-box-form input[type="submit"]:hover,
#search-top-box-form input[type="submit"]:focus {
  background: var(--red);
  border: 2px solid var(--gold);
  color: var(--bg);
  box-shadow: none;
  font-size: 100%;
}

#header-extra-div-1, #extra-div-1 {
  position: fixed;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 21px;
  background: var(--red);
  border: solid var(--gold);
}

#header-extra-div-1 {
  top: 0;
  border-width: 0 0 5px 0;
  z-index: 12;
}
#extra-div-1 {
  bottom: 0;
  border-width: 5px 0 0 0;
  z-index: 15;
}
#extra-div-1::before {
  content: "⚠️ 創作上の政治風刺・CC BY-SA 3.0";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--bg);
}
#extra-div-1::after {
  content: "このテーマは架空の独裁体制を扱う創作上の意匠です。\A実在する政権や政策を支持するものではありません。\A特記なき内容はCC BY-SA 3.0に従います。";
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 26px;
  padding: 0.5em 1em;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  transform: scaleY(0) translateX(-50%);
  transform-origin: bottom;
  background: var(--red);
  color: var(--bg);
  text-align: center;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  transition: all 0.3s;
}
#extra-div-1:hover::after {
  transform: scaleY(1) translateX(-50%);
  transition: all 0.3s;
}

#extra-div-2 {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 1000px;
  background: linear-gradient(var(--bg) 80%, transparent);
  z-index: -1;
}

#extra-div-3 {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: url("data:image/png;base64,") right/100% repeat-y;
  z-index: -2;
}

#extra-div-4 {
  position: absolute;
  top: 800px;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -26px;
  background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.15) 800px);
  z-index: 20;
  pointer-events: none;
}

#page-title, h1, #header, #search-top-box-form input[type="submit"], #side-bar, #extra-div-1::before, .yui-navset .yui-nav a {
  font-family: "Yu Gothic", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", Meiryo, "IPAPGothic", sans-serif;
}

#side-bar .heading {
  font-weight: normal;
}

#side-bar .side-block .menu-item {
  letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
}

#side-bar a, #side-bar .collapsible-block-link, #side-bar div.menu-item a {
  text-shadow: 1px 1px 1px var(--text), 1px -1px 1px var(--text), -1px 1px 1px var(--text), -1px -1px 1px var(--text);
  font-weight: normal;
}

#page-title, h1 {
  font-weight: 700;
}

h1 { color: var(--text); }

.page-rate-widget-box {
  filter: brightness(1.2) saturate(1.2);
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: 40px;
}

#page-content .rate-box-with-credit-button {
  background-color: var(--red);
  border-color: var(--red);
  margin-bottom: 40px;
}

#page-content .creditButton p a:hover {
  color: var(--gold);
}

#page-content .page-rate-widget-box::after {
  content: "創作上の注意 ⚠️";
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
  right: 0;
  width: max-content;
}
#page-content .rate-box-with-credit-button .page-rate-widget-box::after { right: -20px; }
#page-content .creditBottomRate .page-rate-widget-box::after { content: none; }

#page-content .creditBottomRate { height: 70px; }
#page-content .creditBottomRate::before {
  content: "⚠️ このページは創作上の意匠であり、\A実在する政権や政策を支持するものではありません。";
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  line-height: 1.4;
  position: absolute;
  text-align: center;
  bottom: 5px;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
}

#u-credit-view { z-index: 20; }

.chapter {
  margin: 0.25em;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 2.5em;
  color: var(--red);
  text-shadow: 2px 2px var(--gold);
  font-family: "Yu Mincho", "Hiragino Mincho ProN", "IPAMincho", serif;
  font-style: italic;
  word-break: keep-all;
}

span.kim {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 101%;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-family: "Yu Gothic", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", Meiryo, "IPAPGothic", sans-serif;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

div.tower, div.towerline {
  position: fixed;
  top: calc(var(--towerwidth) + 25px);
  left: var(--towerleft);
  width: var(--towerwidth);
  height: 650px;
}

div.tower {
  clip-path: polygon(0% 0%, 0% 100%, 2% 100%, 2% 86.5%, 1% 86.5%, 1% 84.5%, 4% 84.5%, 4% 70.5%, 3% 70.5%, 3% 68.5%, 6% 68.5%, 6% 53.5%, 5% 53.5%, 5% 51.5%, 8% 51.5%, 8% 36.5%, 7% 36.5%, 7% 34.5%, 10% 34.5%, 10% 19.5%, 9% 19.5%, 9% 17.5%, 12% 17.5%, 12% 2.5%, 11% 2.5%, 11% 0.5%, 89% 0.5%, 89% 2.5%, 88% 2.5%, 88% 17.5%, 91% 17.5%, 91% 19.5%, 90% 19.5%, 90% 34.5%, 93% 34.5%, 93% 36.5%, 92% 36.5%, 92% 51.5%, 95% 51.5%, 95% 53.5%, 94% 53.5%, 94% 68.5%, 97% 68.5%, 97% 70.5%, 96% 70.5%, 96% 84.5%, 99% 84.5%, 99% 86.5%, 98% 86.5%, 98% 100%, 100% 100%, 100% 0%);

  background: var(--bg);
  z-index: 8;
}

div.towerline {
  clip-path: polygon(0.5% 0.5%, 0.5% 100%, 3% 100%, 3% 86%, 2% 86%, 2% 85%, 5% 85%, 5% 70%, 4% 70%, 4% 69%, 7% 69%, 7% 53%, 6% 53%, 6% 52%, 9% 52%, 9% 36%, 8% 36%, 8% 35%, 11% 35%, 11% 19%, 10% 19%, 10% 18%, 13% 18%, 13% 2%, 12% 2%, 12% 1%, 88% 1%, 88% 2%, 87% 2%, 87% 18%, 90% 18%, 90% 19%, 89% 19%, 89% 35%, 92% 35%, 92% 36%, 91% 36%, 91% 52%, 94% 52%, 94% 53%, 93% 53%, 93% 69%, 96% 69%, 96% 70%, 95% 70%, 95% 85%, 98% 85%, 98% 86%, 97% 86%, 97% 100%, 99.5% 100%, 99.5% 0.5%);

  background: var(--text);
  z-index: 7;
}

div.toweron, div.toweroff {
  top: calc(var(--towerwidth) + 25px);
  left: calc(var(--towerleft) + 1px);
  width: calc(var(--towerwidth) - 2px);
}

div.toweron {
  position: absolute;
  height: 120vh;
  background: rgba(255,255,200,0.6);
  backdrop-filter: brightness(2) blur(2px);
  mask: linear-gradient(rgb(0, 0, 0) 20%, transparent);
  z-index: 3;
}

div.toweroff {
  position: fixed;
  height: 650px;
  background: #555;
  z-index: 1;
}

div.light {
  position: fixed;
  top: 26px;
  left: var(--towerleft);
  width: var(--towerwidth);
  height: var(--towerwidth);
  background: url("data:image/png;base64,") center/cover no-repeat;
  z-index: 9;
}

div.lighton {
  position: absolute;
  top: 27px;
  left: calc(var(--towerleft) + 1px);
  width: calc(var(--towerwidth) - 2px);
  height: calc(var(--towerwidth) - 2px);
  mask: linear-gradient(var(--text) 50%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: brightness(1.2) saturate(1.8) contrast(2);
  z-index: 5;
}

div.lightoff {
  position: fixed;
  top: 27px;
  left: calc(var(--towerleft) + 1px);
  width: calc(var(--towerwidth) - 2px);
  height: calc(var(--towerwidth) - 2px);
  background: url("data:image/png;base64,") center/contain no-repeat;
  z-index: 4;
}

blockquote, div.blockquote {
  border: 2px solid var(--text);
  box-size: border-box;
  background: var(--paper);
}

.yui-navset .yui-nav {
  border: none;
}

.yui-navset .yui-nav a,
.yui-navset .yui-nav a em,
.yui-navset .yui-nav .selected a, .yui-navset .yui-nav .selected a em {
  border: none;
}

.yui-navset .yui-nav a {
  background: var(--gold);
  padding: 0.25em 1.25em;
  filter: brightness(1.1);
  clip-path: polygon(10px 0%, 0% 100%, 100% 100%, calc(100% - 10px) 0%);
  font-size: 110%;
  color: var(--text);
  position: relative;
}

.yui-navset .yui-nav .selected,
.yui-navset .yui-nav li {
  margin: -1px -0.5em -1px 0;
  max-width: 100%;
}

.yui-navset .yui-nav a:hover, .yui-navset .yui-nav a:focus {
  background: var(--gold);
  filter: brightness(1.2);
  z-index: 1;
}

.yui-navset .yui-nav .selected a, .yui-navset .yui-nav .selected a:focus, .yui-navset .yui-nav .selected a:hover {
  background: var(--gold);
  filter: brightness(1);
  color: var(--red);
  z-index: 2;
}

.yui-navset .yui-content {
  border: 7px solid var(--gold);
  box-size: border-box;
  background: var(--paper);
  padding: 0.5em 1em;
  z-index: 3;
}

.yui-content blockquote,
.yui-content div.blockquote,
blockquote blockquote,
blockquote div.blockquote,
div.blockquote blockquote,
div.blockquote div.blockquote {
  background: #E5E5E2;
}

.yui-content a, blockquote a, div.blockquote a {
  filter: brightness(0.9);
}

table.wiki-content-table th {
  background-color: var(--gold);
  color: var(--red);
  font-family: "Yu Gothic", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", Meiryo, "IPAPGothic", sans-serif;
}

.thread-container .post .head {
  background: var(--red);
  color: var(--bg);
}

.thread-container .post .options a {
  color: var(--gold);
}

@media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 979px) {
  #top-bar ul li.sfhover ul li a, #top-bar ul li:hover ul li a {
    width: 150px;
  }
  #top-bar ul li ul li ul {
    left: 173px;
  }
}

@media(min-width: 768px) {
  #header h1 {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding-left: 10vw;
  }

  #top-bar .top-bar { display: flex; }

  /* The Korean branch navigation positions are not stable SCP-JP selectors. */

  #side-bar {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 1;
    top: 315px;
    left: var(--towerleft);
    bottom: 15px;
    margin-left: 31px;
    overflow-y: scroll;
    z-index: 15;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }
  #side-bar::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }

  #side-bar .side-block, #side-bar .red, #side-bar .green, #side-bar .blue {
    /* Keep the Korean theme's pale labels readable against SCP-JP's light
       article canvas while preserving its red navigation-panel identity. */
    background: var(--red);
    box-shadow: none;
    border: none;
    filter: brightness(1.2);
  }

  #page-content {
    font-size: 105%;
  }
}

@media(max-width: 767px) {
  :root {
    --towerleft: -100px;
    --towerwidth: 160px;
  }

  #header h1 a::before {
    content: var(--slogan1m) "　\A　" var(--slogan2m) "\A";
    font-size: 150%;
  }

  #login-status, #login-status a { font-size: 0; }
  #account-topbutton { display: none; }

  #main-content {
    padding-left: 50px;
  }

  #top-bar .mobile-top-bar { display: flex; }
  #top-bar .open-menu a {
    bottom: 1em;
    left: 0.3em;
    border-color: var(--gold);
    color: var(--gold);
  }

  #side-bar:target { z-index: 20; }

  #side-bar, #side-bar .side-block, #side-bar .red, #side-bar .green, #side-bar .blue {
    background: var(--red);
  }

  #extra-div-1::after {
    width: 100vw;
  }

  div.light {
    background-position: 20px center;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 580px) {
  #header h1 a {
    padding: 65px 0 25px;
  }
  #header {
    height: 170px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 479px) {
  #header h1 a {
    font-size: 100%;
  }
  #header {
    height: 150px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 385px) {
  #top-bar .mobile-top-bar > ul > li:nth-child(3) > ul > li:nth-child(1) > a {
    padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem 0.3rem 0.4rem;
  }
}

@media (min-height: 932px) {
  div.tower, div.towerline, div.toweroff {
    height: unset;
    min-height: 600px;
    bottom: 0;
  }
}

/* SCP-JP port: preserve the original graphic layers and allow Japanese article samples to use them without external assets. */
.dd-introduction {
  max-width: 38rem;
  margin: 3rem auto;
  padding: 1rem 1.3rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--text);
  background: var(--paper);
}
.dd-introduction h1 { font-size: 1.25rem; text-align: center; }
.dd-emblem {
  width: min(20rem, 75vw);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  margin: 2rem auto;
  background: url("data:image/png;base64,") center / contain no-repeat;
}
.dd-palette {
  width: min(100%, 40rem);
  margin: 2rem auto;
  table-layout: fixed;
  border-spacing: 0.5rem;
  font-family: "Yu Gothic", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", Meiryo, "IPAPGothic", sans-serif;
  text-align: center;
}
.dd-palette td {
  width: 50%;
  padding: 1.5rem 0.5rem;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  box-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--text);
}
.dd-warning {
  margin: 2rem auto;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  max-width: 38rem;
  border-left: 5px solid var(--red);
  background: var(--paper);
}
.dd-mobile-nav { display: none; }
div.toweroff {
  background: url("data:image/png;base64,") center top / 100% auto no-repeat;
  filter: brightness(0.5);
}


/* SCP-JP Wikidot Dear Dictator navigation correction: anchor only the overflowing rightmost menus at their mobile row endpoints. */
@media (max-width: 359px) {
  #top-bar .mobile-top-bar > ul > li:nth-last-child(2) > ul { left: auto; right: 0; }
  #top-bar .mobile-top-bar > ul > li:last-child > ul { left: auto; right: 0; }
}
@media (min-width: 360px) and (max-width: 767px) {
  #top-bar .mobile-top-bar > ul > li:last-child > ul { left: auto; right: 0; }
}

/* THEME_LAB_AUTHORITY_BLOCK_BOUNDARY */

/* SCP-JP Wikidot dear-dictator credit correction: keep the modal rating in document flow below the license control. */
#u-credit-view .modalbox .modalbox-ratemodule { position: static; }


/* THEME_LAB_AUTHORITY_BLOCK_BOUNDARY */

/* SCP-JP Wikidot Dear Dictator control correction: keep mobile navigation inside the viewport above the search layer. */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  #top-bar { z-index: 20 !important; }
  #top-bar .mobile-top-bar { position: fixed !important; inset: 0 0 auto 0 !important; z-index: 20 !important; }
  #search-top-box { z-index: 14 !important; width: auto !important; max-width: calc(100vw - 7rem) !important; }
  #search-top-box-form { width: auto !important; }
}
/* THEME_LAB_AUTHORITY_BLOCK_BOUNDARY */
/* SCP-JP Wikidot Dear Dictator mobile search correction: keep search below an unwrapped, readable navigation row. */
@media (max-width: 979px) {
  #search-top-box { top: 1.5rem !important; }
}
@media (max-width: 359px) {
  #top-bar .mobile-top-bar > ul {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
    justify-content: space-between !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
  }
  #top-bar .mobile-top-bar > ul > li {
    flex: 0 0 auto !important;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
}

[[/module]]

[[div class="dd-mobile-nav"]]
[#side-bar ☰ メニュー]　[#page-content 閉じる]
[[/div]]

[[/div]]

[[/div]]

[[/div]]
[[div class="toweroff"]]
[[/div]]

[[/div]]

[[/div]]
